nodes.name: Cryptostock
nodes.description: An IoT based alert system which sent messages to the user on Telegram when the price of a particular cryptocurrency was above a particular price

nodes.name: diseasedetector
nodes.description: Contains X ray images of covid and non covid cases in train and test set. Achieves an accuracy of 98%.

nodes.name: Neural-Networks-and-Fuzzy-Logic
nodes.description: Collection of basic algorithms from scratch implemented in python. Done as a part of the course BITS F312 Neural Networks and Fuzzy Logic.

nodes.name: Automatic-Billing-System-For-Shopping-Cart
nodes.description: In this project, we provide three inputs corresponding to three different items that need to be billed for a shopping cart. The items can be added any number of times by the user. When the user presses Pay, the amount is paid, and the cost is reset to zero. A reset function is provided, which resets the cost to zero for a new transaction cycle.

nodes.name: Human-brain-storage-simulator
nodes.description: Implementation of the paper https://doi.org/10.31219/osf.io/58adh. The code simulates the human memory model as described in the paper.

nodes.name: Wafer_Map_Defect_Detection
nodes.description: A deep learning pipeline for classifying semiconductor wafer map defects.
